entries.title: Psalms 26:2
segments: The humble and penitent believer will not trust to his own heart, but knowing its deceitfulness he will habitually apply to God to search him and try him, and to lead him in the way everlasting.

entries.title: Psalms 26:4
segments:
Vain persons; persons of falsehood. 
 
  Disemblers; hypocrites.

entries.title: Psalms 26:6
segments:
Wash my hands; avoid all impurity. 
 
  Compass thine altar; that I may there offer sacrifices to thee. 
 
An indispensible prepartion for worshipping God acceptably, is the putting away of iniquity in heart and life.

entries.title: Psalms 26:8
segments: The dwelling place of God is peculiarly dear to his people, and their joy in the manifestations of his presence gives them reason to hope that they shall dwell with him for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 26:9
segments: Gather not my soul with sinners; take not away my soul with sinners.

entries.title: Psalms 26:11
segments: While the people of God are careful to be sincere, upright, and honest in their lives, and trust for salvation only in the mercy of God in Christ Jesus, they stand on firm ground, and may walk in safety through all the snares and dangers of life.

entries.title: Psalms 26:12
segments: Even place; on firm, solid ground.
